name: Kami: Parade of Senses
source:
The game is set in an alternative Europe during the latter half of the 20th century. Not long ago, a war known as the «Mindless War» finally came to an end. Against the backdrop of the adoption of the law on religious tolerance, a large number of religious organizations are being formed, one of which is the Order of Kami. The Order’s true goals, the core of its faith, and the history of its creation remain a mystery to all but a select few.

While reading about this Order in the morning paper, our protagonist receives a letter: a job invitation. In a country ravaged by unemployment and having only recently finished rehabilitation from the scars of the Mindless War, they find themselves without alternatives. And so, they head to the interview.

The job seems simple enough, requiring no prior experience. All they have to do is test a new development at the Institute of Advanced Research and Technology…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2764320/Kami_Parade_of_Senses/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
游戏背景设定在20世纪下半叶的另一个欧洲。不久前，一场被称为“无心战争”的战争终于落下了帷幕。在宗教宽容法通过的背景下，一大批宗教组织正在形成，神明会就是其中之一。除了少数人之外，该组织的真正目标、其信仰的核心及其创建的历史对所有人来说仍然是个谜。

当我们在早报上读到这个命令时，我们的主人公收到了一封信：一份工作邀请。在一个饱受失业蹂躏、刚刚从无意识战争的伤疤中恢复过来的国家，他们发现自己别无选择。因此，他们前往面试。

这项工作看起来很简单，不需要任何经验。他们所要做的就是在高级研究与技术研究所测试一项新开发成果……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2764320/Kami_Parade_of_Senses/]Steam[/url]]
